method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: search_docs
tools.title: Search CM.com documentation
tools.description: Search CM.com product documentation (messaging, payments, voice, verification, signing, ticketing and more) by keywords. Returns page titles, Markdown URLs and summaries; read a page with get_page.

tools.name: get_page
tools.title: Read a documentation page
tools.description: Read one CM.com documentation page as Markdown. Accepts a page URL or path from this site.

tools.name: list_apis
tools.title: List CM.com APIs
tools.description: List published CM.com APIs with their reference documentation and OpenAPI specification URL. Lists every API unless a query narrows it.

query.description: Optional words to narrow the list by API title or product, e.g. "messaging" or "payments v1".

tools.name: get_openapi_spec
tools.title: Get an OpenAPI specification
tools.description: Get the OpenAPI (YAML) specification of a CM.com API. Pass a spec or reference URL from list_apis.

url.description: Spec or API reference URL from list_apis.
